newsitem.title: FRANCE: French unemployment falls for third month in April.
newsitem.headline: French unemployment falls for third month in April.

text.p: French unemployment fell in April for the third month in a row, dipping 6,400 or 0.2 percent to 3,081,100, labour ministry data released on Monday showed.
The information was released in the wake of a second-round parliamentary election runoff vote on Sunday which swept the left wing back into power.
The jobless rate, based on International Labour Organisation criteria which exclude jobseekers who did any work, was unchanged at a record 12.8 percent, the ministry data showed.
